runtime.execution: Public agmmltd-arch/agmm-render-public Ubuntu Actions only. Workflow checks out the exact private Git tree at the root-pinned commit using the existing read-only SSH deploy key, verifies native Git blobs, byte sizes, and protected release SHA256 values on the hosted runner, stages inputs transiently, and executes the pinned public mix runtime. It uploads no audio, stems, or mix derivative.
